title: NCode documentation site configuration
description: Everything that differs between two libraries' documentation sites. The file is site.config.json in the library's content folder (docs/site/ by default). CONTRACT.md in NCodeGroup/docs describes each key.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors.

title.description: The site's name: the browser title of every page, the search index and link previews. For a library, its package name, such as NCode.Buffers.

description.description: One sentence about the library: the default meta description, used by a page that has none of its own.

product.description: The name set beside the mark in the header, such as Buffers. Default: the title.

mark.description: Which lockup the header shows: ncode for a library, ncode-identity for the NCode Identity product. Default: ncode.

version.description: The version label on the header's readout, such as v5. Left out, the header shows none.

repository.description: The library's repository, for the header's link and each page's edit link.

url.description: The repository's URL, without a trailing slash, such as https://github.com/NCodeGroup/Buffers.

branch.description: The default branch, which edit links open. Default: main.

site.description: Where the site is served when the build is not told otherwise.

url.description: The site's URL with its base path and no trailing slash, such as https://ncodegroup.github.io/Buffers. The SITE_URL environment variable, which the workflow sets from the repository's Pages settings, replaces it; a pull request build and a local build use this value.

sidebar.description: The navigation: groups in the order they are shown.

social.description: The links in the header. Default: one link to the repository, labelled GitHub.

label.description: The link's text, such as GitHub or NuGet.

samples.description: Globs, relative to the repository root, of the source files that hold sample regions. Each file a glob matches is checked by its real path, with every symbolic link followed, against the root's real path: a file outside the repository stops the build, whether a pattern or a link leads there, and a link that stays inside is read like any file. Folders named bin, obj, node_modules, TestResults and .git are never read, also where a link leads into one. Default: ["tests/**/*.cs"].

items.description: A glob relative to the repository root, with forward slashes, that matches files under it, such as tests/**/*.cs.

editLinks.description: Whether each page links to its source file in the repository. Default: true.

lastUpdated.description: Whether each page shows the date of the last commit that changed it. Default: true.

badge.description: A small label beside the entry.

collapsed.description: Whether the group starts closed. Default: false.

oneOf.description: A page, by its path under the content folder without the extension, such as guides/derive-a-key. Its label is the page's title.
A page with a label of its own.

slug.description: A page's path under the content folder, without the extension and without a slash at the start, such as guides/derive-a-key.

oneOf.description: A link: site-absolute (/guides/derive-a-key/) or an absolute URL.

link.description: A path from the site's root, such as /guides/derive-a-key/, or an https:// URL.

oneOf.description: Every page of a folder, ordered by each page's sidebar.order and then by file name.

directory.description: A folder under the content folder, without a slash at the start, such as guides.
